name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, master]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main, master]

env:
  CARGO_TERM_COLOR: always

jobs:
  check:
    name: Check
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install protoc
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler
      - run: cargo check --workspace

  test:
    name: Test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16
        env:
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      # Full history: the gate parity contract reads the gating set from the base
      # branch as well as from the tree under judgment, and a depth-one checkout
      # has no base branch for it to read. A contract that cannot see the base
      # branch refuses rather than agrees, so the environment has to be able to
      # answer it -- and a pull request's checkout is not the one that can.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      # rustfmt and clippy are requested rather than inherited: the pipeline's
      # format gate runs `cargo fmt --check` and its lint gate runs
      # `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`, and its tests run both here. Whether the
      # action's default profile happens to carry either is not something a gate
      # that refuses changes may depend on.
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
        with:
          components: rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install protoc
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler
      # A red run has to name the test that broke. The job log is behind a
      # token, so without one all that is readable -- by a person or by anything
      # that reads CI status programmatically -- is "the suite failed", which is
      # the state a flaky test hides in: the same commit passes in the other job
      # that runs this suite, and the two readings cannot be told apart.
      # Annotations need no token, so the failing names are lifted into them.
      # --no-fail-fast so one run names every failing test rather than stopping
      # at the first.
      - name: Run cargo test --workspace
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast 2>&1 | tee /tmp/cargo-test.log || {
            # The panic line names a place, not a cause: the message the
            # assertion carried -- and for an assertion, the values it compared
            # -- is on the lines after it. An annotation that stops at the line
            # number says which test broke and leaves the branch it took
            # unreadable, which is the shape a flake keeps.
            grep --no-group-separator -A 4 -E "^(test .* FAILED|failures:|test result: FAILED|error(\[E[0-9]+\])?:)|panicked at" \
              /tmp/cargo-test.log | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | head -40 | while IFS= read -r line; do
                printf '::error::%s\n' "$line"
              done
            exit 1
          }
      # The keypair the contribution admin hands out is written by our own
      # encoder, so every test we can write about it agrees with itself; the
      # question that decides whether it works is whether the tool that will
      # actually use the key reads the PEM. That binary ships on the runner, so
      # this ran nowhere only because it was ignored and never named -- the same
      # account the live-DB steps below settle. It is fast, and it panics
      # rather than passes when the binary is missing, so it cannot go quiet.
      - name: The generated SSH keypair is readable by ssh-keygen
        run: cargo test -p cog-gateway --lib -- --ignored
      # The capped agent log is the first state this backend can get wrong only
      # after the cap fires: a trim moves every list position, so a reader that
      # indexes by position skips as many records as were dropped and a next
      # sequence taken from the list length hands out numbers already used. Both
      # are invisible until a log crosses the cap, which is to say in
      # production, and the service above makes the server cost nothing here.
      - name: Live-Redis capped agent log
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test wal_redis_trim -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_REDIS_URL: redis://127.0.0.1:6379
      # The two retirement passes are judged on the one thing a fixture cannot
      # hold: they work by asking the server what a key is now, and then acting
      # on the answer. An inbox's emptiness is a stream length the pass never
      # wrote; a log's owner is a registration that may have been renewed after
      # the scan and before the delete, and a pass that deletes on the stale
      # answer takes the tail of an agent that is still reading. Both were
      # expensive in production -- 12,571 inboxes of which 12,568 were empty,
      # and 560 MB of logs belonging to agents that had retired, read off one
      # deployment when the pass was written -- which is why they exist at all,
      # and why the thing they must never get wrong is checked against a real
      # server rather than a stand-in.
      - name: Live-Redis inbox retirement
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test inbox_retirement -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_REDIS_URL: redis://127.0.0.1:6379
      - name: Live-Redis agent log retirement
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test wal_retirement -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_REDIS_URL: redis://127.0.0.1:6379
      # The registry answers two questions through one key: who holds a name,
      # and whether the holder is still beating. The second used to ride on the
      # expiry alone, so a record whose writer died between `SET` and `EXPIRE`
      # read as live forever; a live cluster held twenty of those, three days
      # cold, offered as agents that could be sent work. Expiry and its absence
      # are the server's own facts -- a fixture store has no clock to lose one
      # against -- so the record that lost its expiry is planted here, on the
      # server, and the registry is asked what it makes of it.
      - name: Live-Redis agent registry liveness
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test agent_registry_liveness -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_REDIS_URL: redis://127.0.0.1:6379
      - name: Live-DB partition tests
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test partition_maintainer -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The decision counters are a sum the database keeps, and the one read a
      # DB-free test cannot take is two writers counting into the same cell at
      # once: a store that reads, adds and writes back loses an increment, while
      # a test that writes one row and reads it back passes against exactly that
      # store. The table also refuses successes above attempts, and that
      # invariant lives on the server -- the file that this table replaced could
      # not have it at all.
      - name: Live-DB decision counters
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test decision_stats_store -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The change ledger's reason column is written through one statement and
      # read through a fixed column list, and both are the kind of coupling a
      # DB-free test cannot see: a column added to the write and not the read
      # fails only against a server, and "a reason outside the closed set is
      # refused" is a fact about the column's own constraint. Without this the
      # round trip that the reason column exists to make possible is never run.
      - name: Live-DB change-ledger store
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test change_ledger_store -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The backup account's write path is statements whose whole content is what
      # the server does with them: whether the conflict clause wrote a row decides
      # if a repeated opening moved a start instant already recorded, whether the
      # closing's guard matched is what makes a terminal row unrewritable, and
      # whether the pass over the overdue runs concluded one row or two is decided
      # by the deadline each of those rows carries rather than by anything the
      # caller passes in. All of those are facts about `rows_affected` and about a
      # `WHERE` the server evaluated, so a DB-free test cannot see any of them --
      # the closed set on the outcome, likewise, is the column's constraint and
      # not a check in the caller.
      - name: Live-DB backup-run store
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test backup_run_store -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The transcript's three claims are the database's: that a turn is written
      # as a pair in one statement so no reader sees a question whose answer is
      # still in flight, that the bound trims per session rather than across the
      # table, and that a new handle reads the same conversation -- the last one
      # being the whole point, since what this replaced lived in one process.
      - name: Live-DB chat turn store
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test chat_turn_store -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The catalog's one invariant is a unique constraint and its optional
      # columns are nullable on purpose: that a version holds one content, that
      # an absent row count stays absent instead of becoming zero, and that the
      # ordering a restore depends on is the database's. All three are decided by
      # the server, so no in-memory fake can see them.
      - name: Live-DB dataset catalog
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test dataset_catalog -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The principle ledger's intake is keyed on `(slug, source)`, so every
      # later reading of a principle lands on the row already queued for it, and
      # whether that row is rewritten is decided by the conflict clause alone --
      # which branch of an `ON CONFLICT` runs is a fact about the server, and so
      # is whether `rows_affected` counted a row. A clause that leaves the
      # existing row alone drops corrected readings while reporting the pass as
      # done, and no reading of the account can show it: the queue is the only
      # path to the account, so a reading it refused is one the account never
      # gets. Without this step that shape passes everything.
      - name: Live-DB principle-ledger intake
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test principle_ledger_intake -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The set a measuring pass looks at is a bounded query, and what the bound
      # cuts is decided by an ordering the server evaluates. A row whose verdict
      # is "a person holds this" writes no measurement, so it keeps a null
      # `measured_at` and returns to the head of every pass; once more of them
      # exist than the bound takes, the pass judges those same rows forever and
      # reports a full set rather than a stopped one. No DB-free test can see
      # which rows a `NULLS FIRST` ordering hands back.
      - name: Live-DB principle-ledger outstanding set
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test principle_ledger_outstanding -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The census counts the corpus, and the account also holds rows that are
      # not corpus: a gate records its own refusals under its own name, and
      # those rows carry no state by construction. Which rows a grouped count
      # covered cannot be seen from the values -- a count is one number per
      # group either way -- so the predicate that separates the two has to be
      # run against a server.
      - name: Live-DB principle-ledger census
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test principle_ledger_census -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The sample-log sweep is expressed almost entirely as one DELETE, so its
      # correctness cannot be checked without a server; the DB-free tests beside
      # it only cover the sweep period. Leaving these out of the gate is how a
      # sweep that kept every row sharing the newest instant passed both the
      # local gate and CI.
      - name: Live-DB metrics sample capacity sweep
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test metrics_sample_cap -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # Retention is one DELETE, and the exception inside it is what keeps the
      # table honest: read rows expire, unread rows do not, however old they are.
      # Dropping that predicate leaves a statement that still deletes, still
      # reports a count and still shrinks a table, so nothing about the pass
      # looks different until an unread notification is removed before its
      # reader sees it. Only the server can say which rows a WHERE kept.
      - name: Live-DB notification retention
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test notification_retention -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # Which replica may act is decided by one statement, and the acceptance
      # for it is a question about two processes: two asks landing at once leave
      # exactly one holder, and a holder that stops renewing loses the role to
      # whoever asks next. The statement's text is guarded beside its producer
      # without a server; that guard cannot tell a statement that yields from one
      # that takes, so this is the half that holds.
      - name: Live-DB owner-lease arbitration
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test owner_lease -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # Which transitions the owner guard lets through is decided in the
      # statement that runs the write, and the answer is not visible from the
      # call sites: a check that reads status alone lets a unit move work it
      # does not own, and the write succeeds either way. One thread, because
      # each test builds the schema on the shared database first: run together
      # they create the same types at once and the catalog refuses the second.
      - name: Live-DB task ownership guard
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test task_ownership_store -- --ignored --test-threads=1
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # A face is a task row, and every rule the governance layer trusts is a
      # claim about which rows a query selects -- which rows are faces, which
      # are open work for one, and which a handover moves. A read that matches
      # the wrong type returns an empty registry, which reads as "no faces"
      # rather than as a broken query, and a handover that moved a running task
      # would leave its lease and its owner describing two units. Those shapes
      # are invisible without a server, so the statements are run against one.
      # One thread, because each test builds the schema on the shared database
      # first: run together they create the same types at once and the catalog
      # refuses the second.
      - name: Live-DB governance store reads
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test governance_store -- --ignored --test-threads=1
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # What a single pruning statement costs, and which rows it takes. The
      # rank question is a plan question: ranking every row of the log first
      # answers it for the whole table, which is a cost no reading of the
      # statement's text shows.
      - name: Live-DB metrics surplus-delete statement
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test metrics_surplus_delete -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The gauge read and the retirement pass were written as live tests and
      # then never named by any gate, which is the same as not having them: a
      # scrape pays for the newest-sample read continuously, and the retirement
      # has to reach every table a retired name is stored in. Both run here so
      # the claim is checked rather than asserted.
      - name: Live-DB metrics latest-sample read
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test metrics_latest_reading -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # A `_total` series is read by differencing two scrapes, so the stored
      # total has to be accumulated -- and a boot-time seed of a closed set
      # writes zeros over totals other processes have counted up, which only
      # works while the write adds. Whether Postgres's upsert adds is a question
      # only a server answers, and an assigning one would look healthy from
      # every call site.
      - name: Live-DB counter totals accumulate
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test metrics_counter_accumulation -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # One task id is not one run: the pipeline hands the same id to its
      # planner, generator and evaluator, and each reports only its own usage.
      # The per-task row is read as the task's cost, so a later run has to add
      # rather than replace it — and which one the conflict clause does is a
      # fact about the server. Replacing keeps every row plausible and drops
      # every role but the last, which no DB-free test can see.
      - name: Live-DB task census accumulates runs
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test observability_task_census -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # A task's event offsets are the backend's to assign, and Postgres derives
      # them from a count two writers can read before either has inserted --
      # while a reclaimed lease presumes the previous holder stopped rather than
      # stopping it. Whether the table refuses a position it already gave out,
      # and whether a page follows the position or the task's whole history, are
      # both questions only a server answers.
      - name: Live-DB event offset sequence
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test events_offset_sequence -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The same append read back through `get_events` must mean the same event
      # whichever backend is wired, and the one production runs stored the event
      # itself in the payload column rather than the payload. Whether the read
      # undoes exactly that much is a question only a server answers: an
      # in-memory double answers it the way its own implementation behaves, and
      # that is the implementation that was right.
      - name: Live-DB event payload round trip
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test events_payload_round_trip -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # Whether an event published through the trait object reaches the table
      # is a question the concrete type cannot answer: production holds the
      # gateway as `dyn ObservabilityGateway`, and the fault this pins is that
      # the trait arm sent without writing while the table stayed empty and
      # read as "no events happened". The write is spawned, so the wait for the
      # row and the schema it lands in are both the server's to settle.
      - name: Live-DB observability event persistence
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test observability_event_persistence -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      - name: Live-DB retires a metrics name
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test metrics_retirement -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # One test in this binary restores a package written by an older image and
      # kept on the host's volume; its input is not something a runner can build
      # for itself, and the test refuses rather than passes when the input is
      # absent. Naming it here is therefore a red that says nothing about the
      # code. It is skipped by its exact name -- spelled with `=` so that the
      # ignored-corpus contract still reads every word after ` -- ` as a flag --
      # and runs on a host that was given an extracted package.
      - name: Live-DB backup/restore round trip
        run: cargo test -p cogneva --test backup_pg -- --ignored --skip=pg_restore_loads_a_package_written_before_the_schema_moved_on
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The platform-identity lookup fails at parse time against the real
      # schema (both tables own an `id`), so it cannot be caught without a
      # server. Leaving it out of the gate is how a query that is only reached
      # on a first login stays broken while every DB-free test passes.
      - name: Live-DB platform identity lookup
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test platform_identity -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The notification store's insert is a statement only the server parses,
      # and its owner is a column the contract carries as a string. Without a
      # server a row that can never be written, a page boundary that repeats
      # rows, or a read that answers for every user at once all leave every
      # DB-free test green.
      - name: Live-DB notification store
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test notification_store -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The token ledger's cache column is added by an ALTER that has to land on
      # a table already holding rows, and the INSERT that fills it is a
      # statement only the server parses. Neither face is visible without a
      # server: without this step a column that never gets written, or a
      # migration that rewrites the rows it lands beside, leaves every DB-free
      # test green.
      - name: Live-DB LLM usage ledger
        run: cargo test -p cog-observability --test usage_store_ledger -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The window fold's three claims are all decisions the server makes: that
      # a window's totals are the ledger's sum over it, that rerunning a window
      # lands the same rows with the same values (idempotence rests on the
      # primary key), and that a known combination the window did not use still
      # lands a zero row. A fold that rewrote a window's keys or dropped the
      # idle rows would leave every call site and every DB-free test unchanged.
      # The read's own claim is decided by the server too: the range reported
      # back has to be the range of windows that were summed, because the fold
      # lands closed hours and the trailing hour a caller asks for first is the
      # one window it cannot have reached. A read that answered with the window
      # it was asked for makes an unfolded hour and an idle one the same empty
      # list, and only a server can say which windows exist to be summed.
      - name: Live-DB LLM usage window rollup
        run: cargo test -p cog-observability --test usage_rollup -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The saved calls a call site decided not to make and the verdict a
      # window's silence gets are two claims about rows one writer leaves and
      # another reads: a skip is read back under the stage it named with the
      # reason kept apart from the count, and the fold turns usage rows and
      # silence into `necessary` / `documented_skip` / `unexpected_absent`. Both
      # hinge on the server -- a `GROUP BY` that folds two stages into one, a
      # conflict clause whose key is not the key the reader reads with, and
      # whether a re-run lands the same rows are all decided there, and each of
      # them passes every DB-free test beside it. The three verdicts are checked
      # in one run because the difference between them is the claim: a face that
      # can report only one of them answers the same word every time and passes
      # any single assertion.
      - name: Live-DB LLM skip and spend verdict
        run: cargo test -p cog-observability --test skip_and_verdict_round_trip -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The alert DDL is one multi-statement string sent through the simple
      # query protocol, so the server parses all of it and a malformed statement
      # anywhere inside stops every statement before it from landing. That is
      # how the notification mark was absent on a deployment whose binary wrote
      # it: the code compiled, the DB-free tests passed, and the only witness
      # was a warning at startup. The queue queries are server decisions too --
      # which rows a firing row without the mark returns, and whether a new
      # firing episode clears the mark so the next episode is announced.
      - name: Live-DB alert schema and notification mark
        run: cargo test -p cog-observability --test alert_schema -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The alert mirror decides what to close by subtracting the keys it just
      # read from the rows the store says it owns. Both ends are server
      # answers: ownership is a JSONB label lookup, and "still firing" is a
      # state column. A lookup that matched nothing would make the subtraction
      # empty and the mirror would report a clean reconciliation every tick
      # while every row it opened stayed firing -- the shape measured on
      # 2026-10-23, six rows frozen at one second. The other half of the
      # reading is that rows of other producers and resolved rows are *not*
      # returned, because returning them would have the mirror announce
      # recoveries that never happened.
      - name: Live-DB alert mirror ownership
        run: cargo test -p cog-observability --test alert_mirror_source -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # Adoption and retirement ask the store "which of my rules still have a
      # firing row". A read that returns the newest N rows answers that
      # question only for rules whose rows happen to be young: a busy rule
      # pushes an older one past the cutoff, and the caller reads the empty
      # answer as "it recovered" -- adopting nothing after a restart, or
      # settling a row that never closed. The test seeds a thousand newer rows
      # so a bounded read loses the three rows under test; the rule list
      # replaces the row count.
      #
      # The step names the whole lib rather than filtering to the one test by
      # name: a name filter that matches nothing exits 0, so the step would go
      # green after a rename having run nothing, and the ignored-test corpus
      # contract refuses to read a filter it cannot resolve to a test it knows.
      # There is one ignore-marked test in this crate's lib, so the whole-lib
      # form costs nothing today.
      - name: Live-DB watcher adoption and retirement reach every row
        run: cargo test -p cog-observability --lib -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # A taste submission is evidence and a claimable row at once, and both
      # faces are decided by one statement each: whether a second disposition
      # rewrites the first fate, and whether a re-sent id replaces the words
      # already stored. Both are questions only a server answers -- an
      # implementation that overwrote either would leave every call site and
      # every DB-free test unchanged, and would only show up as a submission
      # whose recorded fate or wording disagrees with the work filed for it.
      - name: Live-DB taste intent claims
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test taste_intent_store -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres
      # The status census is one GROUP BY plus a branch that decides what a
      # status string this build cannot name does to the total; neither is
      # visible without a server. It runs last because it empties the task
      # table on entry and exit.
      - name: Live-DB task status census
        run: cargo test -p cog-storage --test task_status_counts -- --ignored
        env:
          COGNEVA_TEST_DATABASE_URL: postgres://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/postgres

  fmt:
    name: Format
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - run: cargo fmt --all -- --check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # Pinned, and it is the version that has to be bumped on purpose. Floating
      # stable changed this gate under the tree: 1.99 added lints that no commit
      # in review had anything to do with, and because `cargo` stops at the
      # first crate that fails, each fix exposed the next one a run later. The
      # same pin is used by every job here; a toolchain that is about to judge
      # a tree should be a decision recorded in the tree.
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
        with:
          components: clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install protoc
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler
      - run: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings

  # 仓库自身产物上的散文规则。这一组读的是**源码注释**这类既成的面，不编不跑，
  # 所以既不属于 fmt/clippy（那两条读编译器），也不属于 deploy-parity（那条读渲染
  # 清单）。每条判据的形态都一样：扫一个已有面，命中即红，判词指到行。
  repo-conventions:
    name: Repo Conventions
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # 提交信息是在 history 里的，depth=1 的 checkout 读不到本次推送新增的那几个
      # 提交——而判的正是它们。
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      # 注释不得引用文档：文档在仓库之外，读代码的人跟不过去；修法是把 why 就地
      # 写清，不是把引用换个说法。
      - name: Check comments cite no document
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-comment-doc-references.sh
      # 注释不得把某一台机器的容量写成软件的属性：注释不参与渲染、不参与 parity、
      # 不进任何告警，写错的数字没有读者会红。存量已按行内容记进基线（只许缩），
      # 新写的一条要么说清是谁的数（实测／本机／默认／例如），要么写机制与比例。
      - name: Check comments state whose capacity they quote
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-comment-capacity-figures.sh
      # README 里点名的源码路径必须存在。死在正文里的路径不会让任何东西失败——
      # 文件搬了家，正文照常渲染成一句看着完整的说明，只有读者照着去开文件才发现
      # 是个死指针。判的是反引号括起来、带扩展名的串（口径见脚本头部）。
      - name: Check README paths exist
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-readme-paths.sh
      # 编译期内嵌的文件必须真的在镜像构建上下文里。这条失败只在 tag 发版的镜像
      # job 上现形：从开发树（以及本机发布脚本）编永远看得见那些文件，
      # `.dockerignore` 却把它们挡在上下文之外。2026-10-19 实测它静默红了一个多月，
      # 期间没有一次普通推送会走到那条路上——所以判据要挪到每一次推送都跑的地方。
      - name: Check the image build context carries embedded files
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-docker-context.sh
      # 提交信息不得带 AI 署名。署名在 message 里，diff 与评审都看不见，推出去之后
      # 唯一的修法是重写 history——所以判的是**本次推送新增的提交**，不是整部 history：
      # 整部扫一次等于「第一次失手之后永久红」，而永久红的门最后会被删掉。
      # 范围按事件算：PR 读 base/head，push 读 before/sha；before 全零（新建分支）时
      # 退回「HEAD 可达的全部」。范围算不出来时脚本自己拒绝，不静默放行。
      - name: Check commit messages carry no AI attribution
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.before }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: |
          base="${BASE_SHA}"
          case "${base}" in
            "" | 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000) base="" ;;
          esac
          if [ -n "${base}" ]; then range="${base}..${HEAD_SHA}"; else range="${HEAD_SHA}"; fi
          echo "judging ${range}"
          bash deploy/scripts/check-commit-attribution.sh "${range}"
      # 公开树里不许把私有仓指出来。第一层锚在所有者句柄上（结构判据），第二层要一份
      # 裸标识名单，而名单进公开文件本身就是泄露 —— 它从 secret 注入。
      #
      # 这里**没有**打开 `REQUIRE_PRIVATE_IDENTIFIERS`（脚本支持它，测试也钉了它四种
      # 状态）。理由：secret 在不在，只有配了它的人读得出来；从这棵树里读不出来。对一个
      # 读不出来的前提做 fail-closed，等于把「secret 没配」这个状态变成主线常红 —— 而
      # `release-tag` 依赖本 job，常红就是发布停摆，一条把发布卡死的门活不过下一次
      # 有人赶时间。所以这一层缺席时**明说它没跑**（那行 `这一遍没跑` 就是它的读数），
      # 不冒充通过。配上 secret 之后要转 fail-closed，是把上面那行 env 加回来。
      - name: Check public surface carries no private identifier
        env:
          PRIVATE_IDENTIFIERS: ${{ secrets.PRIVATE_IDENTIFIERS }}
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-private-identifiers.sh
      # LLM 平等：业务侧的清单与配置零厂商名、零厂商 env，真上游只住在网关的上游池。
      # 方言词（openai/anthropic）是协议名，不是厂商身份——判据锚在凭证 env、端点、
      # 域名、模型品牌这些**带身份的形状**上，所以那两个词不会被误伤。
      - name: Check business side is vendor-neutral
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-llm-equality.sh
      # README 里标成 Trait「定义」的成员表必须与源一致。少列不比列错好：字面上一句话
      # 都没错，错的是读者从这里读出的「这个 Trait 没有那个能力」。分档是它的全部——
      # `example`/`示例` 允许不全（只报数），`definition`/`定义` 差一个就红。
      - name: Check README trait member lists match the source
        run: bash .github/scripts/check-readme-trait-members.sh
      # 令牌花销那条路由的判据是「不写 SQL 的人能看见」——成品是那一屏，不是路由。
      # 路由在、契约测试绿、账上那行也读 landed（它的字面量就是路由自己的路径串），
      # 而面板可以整块消失不让任何东西失败。判的是「从入口可达且被渲染的消费者」，
      # 并要求那一屏读覆盖端点（不读就会把「这段没折叠」显示成「这期间没花销」）。
      - name: Check the token spend route has a rendered consumer
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-web-token-panel.sh
      # 站内通知是通信面在生产上的成品：三条路由 ＋ 一条 WebSocket 推送，缺任何一半
      # 都不会有东西失败。这条门查的是「从入口可达、被渲染、且列表与未读数递进了
      # 一格组件」，外加传输层不许把通知塞进 agent 事件归一化（那会静默丢每一条）。
      - name: Check the notification routes have a rendered consumer
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-web-notification-panel.sh
      # 告警中心是站内通信的另一半：列表 ＋ 确认。确认的四条坏路都不出声——面板消失、
      # 按钮接空回调、确认写了列表不读（刷新又变未确认）、重新 firing 不清旧标记
      # （旧发作的确认盖在新一次上）。门把前端可达性与这三处服务端事实一起判。
      - name: Check the alert list and its acknowledge have a consumer
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-web-alert-panel.sh

  # 上面那条门证的是**消费面**（从入口沿 import 图可达、被一格渲染出来、那一屏读
  # 覆盖端点），它结构上证明不了 `web/` 编得过：类型错、装不上的依赖、打包不进
  # bundle，三条它一条也看不见。构建这一半必须自己有一个作业，否则「新增功能不得
  # 退化」在 web 这一侧没有兑现者——本机跑过一次绿的失败形态是「本机恰好是对的」。
  #
  # 本机变异对照（2026-10-14，跑的就是下面这两步）：`web/src/` 里塞一个类型错 ⇒
  # `npm run build` 退出码 2 并指到那一行；还原后逐字节一致、退出码 0。
  web:
    name: Web Build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # Node 的版本只有一个来源：镜像里构建 WebUI 的那一段。两处各钉各的，某天镜像
      # 升了而这里没跟，就会出现「作业绿、镜像编不过」这种最难归因的形态；所以版本
      # 是从 Dockerfile 读出来的，读不到就红，不是在这里再写一个数。
      - name: Resolve the pinned Node version
        id: nodever
        run: |
          v=$(grep -oP '^FROM node:\K[0-9]+' Dockerfile | head -1)
          [ -n "$v" ] || { echo "未从 Dockerfile 读到 node 基础镜像的版本"; exit 1; }
          echo "Resolved node $v"
          echo "version=$v" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ steps.nodever.outputs.version }}
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json
      # `npm ci` 而不是 `npm install`：按 lockfile 装，装出来的依赖树与镜像里那一份
      # 同形。改了 package.json 而没更新 lockfile 时它会红，这正是要它红的形态。
      - name: Install the WebUI dependencies
        working-directory: web
        run: npm ci
      # package.json 的 build 就是 `tsc && vite build`：类型错在 tsc 那一半红，
      # 打包失败在 vite 那一半红。
      - name: Build the WebUI
        working-directory: web
        run: npm run build

  entry-scripts:
    name: Entry Scripts Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Install shellcheck
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y shellcheck
      # The list is derived, not hand-written: a hand-written list of names goes
      # quiet when a script is added (measured: a committed gate was missing from
      # this list and CI never ran it).
      - name: Shell lint
        run: |
          mapfile -t scripts < <(git ls-files '*.sh')
          printf 'checking %d scripts\n' "${#scripts[@]}"
          shellcheck -S warning "${scripts[@]}"
      # The chart cases need helm. The version is read from the bootstrapper's
      # HELM_VERSION rather than copied here: trailing whitespace in rendered
      # block scalars differs between helm versions, and two sides picking their
      # own version turns the gate red somewhere unrelated to the change.
      - name: Resolve pinned Helm version
        id: helmver
        run: |
          v=$(grep -oP 'const HELM_VERSION: &str = "\K[^"]+' crates/bootstrap/src/main.rs)
          [ -n "$v" ] || { echo "未从 crates/bootstrap/src/main.rs 读到 HELM_VERSION"; exit 1; }
          echo "Resolved helm $v"
          echo "version=$v" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: azure/setup-helm@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.helmver.outputs.version }}
      # Four of the script tests read manifests through `kubectl kustomize`. The
      # runner image happens to carry a kubectl, which is the same as not having
      # one managed: the day the image drops it, the failure lands inside a test
      # named for something else. Asked for here, the dependency is a step.
      - uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4
      - name: Script tests
        run: |
          # Both roots, globbed rather than listed: the guard's own tests live
          # beside it under .github/ and a hand-kept list is what goes quiet
          # when one is added.
          for t in deploy/scripts/tests/*.test.sh .github/scripts/tests/*.test.sh; do
            echo "== ${t}"
            bash "${t}"
          done
      - name: PowerShell parse check
        run: |
          pwsh -NoProfile -Command "\$errs = \$null; [void][System.Management.Automation.PSParser]::Tokenize((Get-Content -Raw bootstrap.ps1), [ref]\$errs); if (\$errs.Count -gt 0) { \$errs | ForEach-Object { Write-Error \$_ }; exit 1 }; 'bootstrap.ps1 parse OK'"

  coverage:
    name: Code Coverage
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      redis:
        image: redis:7-alpine
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # This job runs the workspace test suite under instrumentation, so it needs
      # the formatter and the linter the same way the test job does: the
      # pipeline's own tests run `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets`. A job
      # that runs those tests without the linter holds them to a host that
      # cannot answer, and the reading it takes is of the job, not the code.
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview, rustfmt, clippy
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install protoc
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler
      - name: Install cargo-llvm-cov
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@cargo-llvm-cov
      # 审计 1.4：--fail-under-lines 基线阈值防退化，只升不降。
      # 2026-07-23 tarpaulin 基线 42.59%、阈值 40；2026-09-07 换 llvm-cov
      # （编译器内生插桩，缓存友好，CI 墙钟砍半），计数口径不同需重标基线。
      # Same reason as the test job: a red run has to name the test that broke,
      # and the log needs a token to read. This job runs the same suite under
      # instrumentation, so a failure here and a failure there are two readings
      # of one flake unless both say which test it was.
      - name: Generate coverage
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          cargo llvm-cov --workspace --cobertura --output-path cobertura.xml --fail-under-lines 40 2>&1 | tee /tmp/coverage.log || {
            # The panic line names a place, not a cause: the message the
            # assertion carried -- and for an assertion, the values it compared
            # -- is on the lines after it. An annotation that stops at the line
            # number says which test broke and leaves the branch it took
            # unreadable, which is the shape a flake keeps.
            grep --no-group-separator -A 4 -E "^(test .* FAILED|failures:|test result: FAILED|error(\[E[0-9]+\])?:)|panicked at" \
              /tmp/coverage.log | grep -v '^[[:space:]]*$' | head -40 | while IFS= read -r line; do
                printf '::error::%s\n' "$line"
              done
            exit 1
          }
      # 上传是给**第三方**的遥测，不是判据：判据在上面那一步（`--fail-under-lines 40`
      # 连同插桩下的测试红）。所以这一步的失败不该有终局权。
      # 实测过为什么必须显式写：`fail_ci_if_error: false` 只管 codecov 自己报的上传失败，
      # **管不住连接层**——`write EPROTO … ssl/tls alert handshake failure (SSL alert 40)`
      # 是 action 进程自己抛的，照样让这一步非零退出、把整个 job 判红。
      # 代价不对称：一次 codecov 抖动 = 该 rev 的 CI 红 = 部署器按设计拒绝滚动
      # **并且**把刚落地的变更自动撤回，而源码树与覆盖率阈值两件事都通过了。
      # 换成 continue-on-error 后，判据那一侧的强度一字未减。
      - name: Upload coverage to Codecov
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v4
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          files: ./cobertura.xml
          fail_ci_if_error: false

  # 部署拓扑 parity：Helm chart 是唯一权威源，其 k3s profile 渲染结果必须与
  # deploy/k3s/ 静态清单（bootstrap 消费）资源集合与工作负载字段全对齐，
  # 防止 chart 与静态清单静默分叉（deploy/scripts/check-deploy-parity.sh）。
  deploy-parity:
    name: Deploy Manifest Parity
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      # 新鲜度门禁是**字节级**比对（重渲染后 diff 已提交产物），而 helm 各版本
      # 渲染块标量的尾随空白不同：放任 setup-helm 取 latest，一次取不到就静默
      # 回落它内置的默认版本（实测 3.18.4 与 4.x 在这份 chart 上产出不同字节），
      # 门禁会在与代码无关的地方红。版本从引导器的 HELM_VERSION 读——安装期就是
      # 用它下载 helm 的，不在这里再抄一份。
      - name: Resolve pinned Helm version
        id: helmver
        run: |
          v=$(grep -oP 'const HELM_VERSION: &str = "\K[^"]+' crates/bootstrap/src/main.rs)
          [ -n "$v" ] || { echo "未从 crates/bootstrap/src/main.rs 读到 HELM_VERSION"; exit 1; }
          echo "Resolved helm $v"
          echo "version=$v" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: azure/setup-helm@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.helmver.outputs.version }}
      - uses: azure/setup-kubectl@v4
      - name: Install pyyaml
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y python3-yaml
      - name: Check helm/kustomize parity
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-deploy-parity.sh
      - name: Check rendered profiles are fresh
        run: bash deploy/scripts/render-deploy.sh --check
      # 配置内容与 Pod 身份的接线：读 Cogneva 配置的工作负载必须带它的 sha256 指纹，
      # 否则只改配置的那次升级不会滚动——配置换了、Pod 还是旧的，而渲染成功、
      # parity 对齐、Pod 全 Running 三面都绿。这条注解此前没有任何门禁看着，
      # 从 chart 与静态清单里一起删掉，上面两道都不会红。
      - name: Check config checksum wiring
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-config-checksum-wiring.sh
      # git 身份自举的接线：Secret 写权的宿主必须带基线仓库 env，且全集群同值。
      # 这类缺陷在渲染期没有症状（清单合法、parity 也绿），只有这条判据盯得住。
      - name: Check git identity wiring
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-git-identity-wiring.sh
      # 凭证持有面：谁碰得到那两个 Secret 对象里的哪个键，逐条对齐登记表。
      # 与上面那条同形——多一个持有者、少一个键，渲染期都没有症状：清单合法、
      # parity 也绿，只是那个 Pod 从此握着平台 token。
      - name: Check credential holder surface
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-credential-holder-surface.sh
      # 宿主凭证面：上一节只看集群里的两个 Secret 对象。宿主上的 unit 是另一条
      # 完全不同的路——root 跑、能读整块盘、要往外网推。把仓库口令写进单元文件的
      # Environment= 或一个 0644 的 env 文件里，渲染期同样没有症状。
      - name: Check host credential surface
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-host-credential-surface.sh
      # 备份覆盖面：每个挂到数据目录的 PVC 都要进备份 Job 的挂载面，且每个数据根的
      # 一级子目录都要被分类过。漏一个 claim、多一棵没人提过的子树，渲染期都没有
      # 症状——清单合法、parity 绿，换机时就是少了一整块。
      - name: Check backup coverage
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-backup-coverage.sh
      # 空白机恢复的步骤顺序：每一步的 requires 都要由更早的一步产出，等网关的
      # 步骤之前要真有一个网关。这条在渲染期同样没有症状——步骤清单读起来是
      # 对的，坏在「第 3 步在第 2 步之前」，只有空白机上跑到一半才会发现。
      - name: Check restore step order
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-restore-order.sh
      # 告警去重身份＝规则名＋返回序列的标签：表达式没把 pod/container 聚合掉的规则，
      # 身份会随报信的 Pod 重建而换新，同一个持续中的状况每次滚动都以全新告警再报一次。
      # 判据读的是表达式结构而不是求值结果（条件此刻不成立时返回零条序列，
      # 「没有序列」与「没有这个标签」在读数上分不开）。
      - name: Check alert rules name their subject, not their reporter
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-alert-rule-subjects.sh
      # 带 on() 的向量比较里「多的一侧」：一侧在同一组连接键下会有多条序列时不写
      # group_left/group_right，Prometheus 在**求值**时直接 422，而表达式语法合法、
      # promtool 绿、按指标名做的检查也绿。于是规则在安宁时一直安静，一进入它要抓的
      # 局面就自己先死掉（2026-10-20：`build_gate_slot_held_too_long` 只在两个构建槽
      # 同时被占时失败——而那正是它存在的理由）。判据读表达式结构（两侧的 by 集对
      # 连接键集），判不动的计数上报，不折进绿里。
      - name: Check alert rules declare the many side of a join
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-alert-rule-join-shape.sh
      # 告警链五环里前四环（读数、产出者、消费者、判据）都有机器可读的答案，第五环
      # 「归谁」没有：2026-10-23 实测表里正 firing 十一行、ack 全空、最老一行开了
      # 5550 分钟，而写者每半分钟还在推进 last_seen_at——不是没人抄，是没人看，而
      # 「该谁看」在系统里根本没有答案。缺的那一跳是「规则 → 面」，它是规则自己的
      # 性质（和它的表达式同级），所以随规则走：带 cogneva_io_managed 的规则必须同时
      # 申报 cogneva_io_face，标签随告警行流进 alerts.labels，读的人才答得出该叫谁。
      # 「面 → 人」那一跳不在这里：面主换人时不该有任何一条规则需要改。
      - name: Check every delivered alert rule declares its face
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-alert-rule-faces.sh
      # 提前期不是规则里该写死的数，是策略输入：清理一次要多久，随盘、随负载、随人变。
      # 写进规则之后它就无法被看见地漂——规则照常响或照常不响,没人知道那个「七天」
      # 代表哪一次的判断。所以读 runway 家族的规则(`_days_to_` / `_headroom_` /
      # `_days_left`)只许比 0:生产者把提前期与「还剩几天减提前期」的余量一起公布,
      # 改提前期是一次公布,不是一次改规则。判不动的(没有任何数值比较)计数上报。
      - name: Check alert rules derive their bound from the reading
        run: python3 deploy/scripts/check-alert-rule-derived-bounds.py
      # 「比自己的平均值快一倍」不是一个界：低基数上噪声翻倍还是噪声，于是这条规则
      # 常红；高基数上又可能太晚。两种错都不改表达式的合法性、不改主体、不改连接形状，
      # 只会让规则一直响或一直静。这一格只按形状判：凡用 deriv/rate/irate 算出速率、
      # 又拿它跟另一个序列的倍数比的规则，必须另有一个跟常数比的绝对下限。年龄跟自己的
      # 周期比（`time() - ts > 6 * period`）不判——两边同为时长，周期本身就是下限。
      - name: Check alert rules put a floor under every ratio
        run: python3 deploy/scripts/check-alert-rule-ratio-floor.py
      # 应用按 X-Forwarded-Proto 拼绝对地址（A2A 名片的 url 就是其中一个），而合成头
      # 测试自己塞头、自己断言，对「反代把这个头写死成另一个 scheme」完全失明：
      # 2026-10-22 现网就是这样给出 `https://<ip>/…`，而这条路由只开明文 web，那个
      # 地址拨过去 404。渲染期没有症状——清单合法、parity 绿、五条集成测试也绿。
      # 这一格拿每套清单自己的 ingress 注解（entrypoint / tls）去对它引用的
      # middleware 写死的值；不写这个头的 middleware 不判，读不到路由退 3 而不是绿。
      - name: Check a rewritten X-Forwarded-Proto matches the route it serves
        run: python3 deploy/scripts/check-ingress-forwarded-proto.py
      # 上面两条只看表达式的形状。`for: 15y`、`[0m]`、`> 0` 写成 `>= 0` 在它们眼里
      # 都合法，而这些规则永远不会（或总是）亮。这一格让 Prometheus 自己的规则引擎跑
      # 一遍夹具：验收普查的三条告警必须真的从空走到 firing，且改坏清单时夹具自己会红。
      # promtool 由脚本从 apt 取包解到临时目录（不安装、不动系统），拿不到则退 3。
      - name: Test acceptance census alert rules fire
        run: bash deploy/scripts/tests/acceptance-census-alert-rules.test.sh
      # 上一步证明的是「通道能用」，不是「都用过」。进程内那一库两百多条规则里，
      # 结构与形状门对每一条一视同仁地绿，而夹具只点过其中几条；剩下的与「没人跑过」
      # 在读数上完全一样。这一格把覆盖做成能读的数（基线内＝欠账），并且拦住**新增**：
      # 新写一条没有夹具的规则，这一笔就红。基线只许缩小，划掉一条＝给它写了夹具。
      - name: Check every alert rule has been shown to fire
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-alert-rule-firing-coverage.sh
      # 样本日志那几条 gauge 的写者身份：容量与容量判定是每个部署自己的声明，
      # 却落在共用表里、series 键就是标签集。值取成 Pod 标签时拿到的是**应用**名，
      # 同一个镜像的每个工作负载都带着它，那道「别家不许顶这一家的声明」的闸
      # 就全失效。与上面那条同形：渲染期没有症状，清单合法、parity 也绿。
      - name: Check deployment-name wiring
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-deployment-name-wiring.sh
      # token 账的环境轴（哪个环境烧的）。值与上面那两条同形：写者身份由部署声明，
      # 写错或漏写在渲染期没有症状——读数照发，只是那一格落进 unknown，
      # 而 unknown 不是环境、不计进任何一家的总数。判据还从代码读闭集，
      # 并盯着「闭集里每个值都要有生产者」这一半（resident_worker 豁免：它的
      # 生产者在会话侧，不在本仓，去树里找反而是错的）。
      - name: Check LLM origin wiring
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-llm-origin-wiring.sh
      # token 账的第三条轴（为哪件事烧的）。前两条轴答不了「这次改动值不值」
      # 「某个任务花了多少」，而按秒摊的配速必然在任务中途拒调用。它的坏法与上面
      # 那条同形：头名拼错、网关不再读、或运行时新加一条 LLM 调用路径忘了盖任务
      # 身份，账照常落行、那一列只是空着，而空读作「没声明」，与「这条轴没接」同形。
      - name: Check LLM task wiring
        run: bash deploy/scripts/check-llm-task-wiring.sh

  bootstrap-cross-platform:
    name: Bootstrap Cross-Platform Check
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install protoc (Linux)
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler
      - name: Install protoc (macOS)
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: brew install protobuf
      - name: Install protoc (Windows)
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: choco install protoc -y
      # 只编译不跑测试：引导器运行时逻辑是 Linux 专属（K3s/buildah），
      # 本矩阵证明它在三平台都能通过编译（cfg 门控无遗漏）
      - run: cargo check -p cogneva-bootstrap

  # The version contract judged on the checkout, with the same reader, the same
  # clauses and the same gate the cluster's deployer runs. It covers the producer
  # the deployer cannot: a change judged here is judged before it lands, while the
  # deployer only ever sees what already arrived. Full history and tags are what
  # the reading is made of -- the declared version over the commits that changed
  # it, and the release tags with the declaration at the commit each points to --
  # and a shallow checkout answers from a history that stops mid-way, so the gate
  # requires depth 0 and fails when the history was not read to its root.
  version-contract:
    name: Version Contract
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@1.99.0
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
      - name: Install protoc
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y protobuf-compiler
      - name: Judge the version contract
        run: |
          cargo run -p cog-reflection --example version_contract -- --repo .git --rev HEAD

  # 发版门禁：只有上面所有检查全绿，才允许把 workspace 版本打成 tag。
  # tag 推送级联触发 release.yml（编译 + GitHub release + GHCR 镜像）；
  # 任一检查失败则本 job 不调度、不打 tag、不发版。tag 已存在时幂等跳过，
  # 因此修复后重跑/再推 main 会自动补发。
  release-tag:
    name: Tag Release After All Checks Pass
    needs:
      - check
      - test
      - fmt
      - clippy
      - repo-conventions
      - entry-scripts
      - coverage
      - deploy-parity
      - bootstrap-cross-platform
      - version-contract
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # Counting how many commits main sits past the nearest release needs the
      # full history and tags, which the default shallow checkout does not have:
      # the judgement then degrades to unreadable instead of reporting a
      # distance.
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Read workspace version
        id: ver
        run: |
          VER="$(bash deploy/scripts/declared-version.sh)"
          echo "version=$VER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "tag=v$VER" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Skip if tag already exists
        id: check
        run: |
          TAG="${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}"
          if git ls-remote --exit-code --tags https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}.git "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo "exists=yes" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            # An existing tag does not mean the version is new: the declaration is
            # written by hand, the tag goes on the commit where it first appeared,
            # and main keeps moving afterwards. Reporting only "already exists"
            # makes a release dozens of commits behind look exactly like one just
            # published.
            label="$(bash deploy/scripts/version-id.sh)"
            echo "Tag $TAG already exists; main is at ${label}"
            case "${label}" in
              "${TAG}-0-"*) ;;
              *) echo "::warning::release ${TAG} 已落后 main（${label}），制品不包含该 tag 之后的提交" ;;
            esac
          else
            echo "exists=no" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Create tag
        if: steps.check.outputs.exists == 'no'
        run: |
          git config user.name "cogneva-bot"
          git config user.email "bot@cogneva.local"
          git tag -a "${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}" -m "Release ${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}"

      - name: Push tag to GitHub (triggers release.yml)
        if: steps.check.outputs.exists == 'no'
        env:
          DEPLOY_KEY: ${{ secrets.DEPLOY_KEY }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh && chmod 700 ~/.ssh
          echo "$DEPLOY_KEY" > ~/.ssh/deploy_key && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/deploy_key
          ssh-keyscan -p 22 github.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null
          GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i ~/.ssh/deploy_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes" \
            git push ssh://git@github.com:22/${{ github.repository }}.git "${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}"

      - name: Push tag to Gitee (enables gitee-release job)
        if: steps.check.outputs.exists == 'no'
        env:
          GITEE_SSH_KEY: ${{ secrets.GITEE_SSH_KEY }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p ~/.ssh && chmod 700 ~/.ssh
          echo "$GITEE_SSH_KEY" > ~/.ssh/gitee_key && chmod 600 ~/.ssh/gitee_key
          ssh-keyscan gitee.com >> ~/.ssh/known_hosts 2>/dev/null
          GIT_SSH_COMMAND="ssh -i ~/.ssh/gitee_key -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes" \
            git push git@gitee.com:hcipengm/cogneva.git "${{ steps.ver.outputs.tag }}"
sampled_files.Dockerfile:
# Multi-stage build for Cogneva (Rust)
# Compatible with Docker, buildah, podman, and containerd (K3s)

# 受限网络（CN）构建参数，默认空 = 官方源；引导器在 CN_MIRROR 模式下传入 TUNA 镜像。
# RUST_TOOLCHAIN：官方源按版本钉死；TUNA 不镜像按版本 channel（仅 stable/beta/nightly），
# CN 模式必须传 stable。
ARG RUST_TOOLCHAIN="1.95.0"
ARG RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER=""
ARG RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT=""
ARG RUSTUP_INIT_URL="https://sh.rustup.rs"
ARG CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE=""
# CN 模式传镜像主机（如 mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn），替换 debian/ubuntu 官方源
ARG APT_MIRROR_HOST=""
# 低内存机器（如 2-4G 空白机）限制 cargo 并行度防 OOM；"default" = 按核数自动
#（不能放空字符串，cargo 会解析报错）
ARG CARGO_BUILD_JOBS="default"
# 版本与来源：由构建脚本从 Cargo.toml / git 注入，写进二进制与镜像 LABEL，
# 让线上镜像能回答"我是哪个版本、哪个 commit"，不依赖浮动 tag :local 追溯。
ARG VERSION=""
ARG GIT_REVISION=""
# The derived label (git describe semantics): declared version plus commits since
# that release plus the rev. The source tree has no .git inside the container, so
# like GIT_REVISION this can only be injected by the builder.
ARG VERSION_ID=""

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 1: Build
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 基底必须 ubuntu 24.04（glibc 2.39），不能用 debian bookworm（glibc 2.36）：
# fastembed/ort 下载的 ONNX Runtime 预编译库引用 __isoc23_*（glibc 2.38+）符号，
# bookworm 上最终链接必挂（undefined symbol: __isoc23_strtoll）。
FROM ubuntu:24.04 AS builder

ARG RUST_TOOLCHAIN
ARG RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER
ARG RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT
ARG RUSTUP_INIT_URL
ARG CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE
ARG APT_MIRROR_HOST
ARG CARGO_BUILD_JOBS
ARG GIT_REVISION
ARG VERSION_ID
ENV CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=${CARGO_BUILD_JOBS} \
    COGNEVA_GIT_REVISION=${GIT_REVISION} \
    COGNEVA_VERSION_ID=${VERSION_ID} \
    RUSTUP_HOME=/usr/local/rustup \
    CARGO_HOME=/usr/local/cargo \
    PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH

WORKDIR /build

# 受限网络：ubuntu 源替换为镜像主机（deb822 与旧格式都覆盖）
RUN if [ -n "$APT_MIRROR_HOST" ]; then \
    sed -i "s|archive.ubuntu.com|$APT_MIRROR_HOST|g; s|security.ubuntu.com|$APT_MIRROR_HOST|g" \
    /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources 2>/dev/null || true; \
    fi

# Install build dependencies (libssl-dev for rustls-tls, pkg-config for sqlx,
# protobuf-compiler for etcd-client, build-essential 提供 cc/g++/libstdc++.so
# —— ort 的 ONNX Runtime C++ 库最终链接需要）
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    pkg-config \
    libssl-dev \
    ca-certificates \
    curl \
    protobuf-compiler \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install the Rust toolchain via rustup (ubuntu 基底不自带 Rust)。
# Cargo.lock contains crates requiring 1.91+, 按 RUST_TOOLCHAIN 钉版本。
# 注意 TUNA 不托管 rustup-init.sh 脚本（404），CN 模式直接拉
# $RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT/dist/<arch>-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init 二进制。
RUN if [ -n "$RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER" ]; then \
    export RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT; \
    arch=$(uname -m); \
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL "$RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT/dist/$arch-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init" -o /tmp/rustup-init && \
    chmod +x /tmp/rustup-init && /tmp/rustup-init -y --default-toolchain none; \
    else \
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf "$RUSTUP_INIT_URL" | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain none; \
    fi && \
    /usr/local/cargo/bin/rustup toolchain install "$RUST_TOOLCHAIN" && \
    /usr/local/cargo/bin/rustup default "$RUST_TOOLCHAIN"

# 受限网络：crates 走 sparse 镜像。注意 TUNA 的 crates 镜像只镜像索引、
# crate 文件回源 static.crates.io（其 config.json 的 dl 字段），国内必挂；
# 必须用 rsproxy（字节 CDN）或 USTC 这类索引+文件都自托管的镜像。
# multiplexing=false 强制 HTTP/1.1，规避 HTTP/2 被中间设备干扰（PROTOCOL_ERROR 重置）
RUN if [ -n "$CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE" ]; then \
    mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo && \
    printf '[source.crates-io]\nreplace-with = "mirror"\n[source.mirror]\nregistry = "sparse+%s"\n\n[http]\nmultiplexing = false\n\n[net]\nretry = 10\n' "$CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE" > /usr/local/cargo/config.toml; \
    fi

# Copy workspace manifest files first for dependency caching.
# 工作区全部 27 个成员的 Cargo.toml 都必须齐全，缺任何一个 workspace 解析直接失败
#（曾经只复制 14 个，导致下面的依赖预热层秒挂、缓存从未生效）。
COPY Cargo.toml ./
COPY Cargo.lock ./
COPY crates/cog-core/Cargo.toml crates/cog-core/
COPY crates/cog-storage/Cargo.toml crates/cog-storage/
COPY crates/cog-llm/Cargo.toml crates/cog-llm/
COPY crates/cog-agent/Cargo.toml crates/cog-agent/
COPY crates/cog-collaboration/Cargo.toml crates/cog-collaboration/
COPY crates/cog-orchestrator/Cargo.toml crates/cog-orchestrator/
COPY crates/cogneva/Cargo.toml crates/cogneva/
COPY crates/cog-auth/Cargo.toml crates/cog-auth/
COPY crates/cog-quota/Cargo.toml crates/cog-quota/
COPY crates/cog-wiki/Cargo.toml crates/cog-wiki/
COPY crates/cog-observability/Cargo.toml crates/cog-observability/
COPY crates/cog-memory/Cargo.toml crates/cog-memory/
COPY crates/cog-reflection/Cargo.toml crates/cog-reflection/
COPY crates/cog-prompt/Cargo.toml crates/cog-prompt/
COPY crates/cog-eval/Cargo.toml crates/cog-eval/
COPY crates/cog-guardrail/Cargo.toml crates/cog-guardrail/
COPY crates/cog-protocol/Cargo.toml crates/cog-protocol/
COPY crates/cog-stream/Cargo.toml crates/cog-stream/
COPY crates/cog-net/Cargo.toml crates/cog-net/
COPY crates/cog-redis/Cargo.toml crates/cog-redis/
COPY crates/cog-notification/Cargo.toml crates/cog-notification/
COPY crates/cog-extension/Cargo.toml crates/cog-extension/
COPY crates/cog-skill/Cargo.toml crates/cog-skill/
COPY crates/cog-gateway/Cargo.toml crates/cog-gateway/
COPY crates/cog-supervisor/Cargo.toml crates/cog-supervisor/
COPY crates/cog-github/Cargo.toml crates/cog-github/
COPY crates/bootstrap/Cargo.toml crates/bootstrap/

# Create dummy sources so the dependency warm-up layer compiles.
# lib 型 crate 必须补空 lib.rs；Cargo.toml 里显式声明的 target
#（cog-storage 的 cog-migrate bin、cog-collaboration 的 pge_cycle bench）也要补占位文件。
RUN for crate in cog-core cog-storage cog-llm cog-agent cog-collaboration cog-orchestrator \
    cogneva cog-auth cog-quota cog-wiki cog-observability cog-memory cog-reflection cog-prompt \
    cog-eval cog-guardrail cog-protocol cog-stream cog-net cog-redis cog-notification cog-extension \
    cog-skill cog-gateway cog-supervisor cog-github bootstrap; do \
    mkdir -p crates/$crate/src && \
    echo '' > crates/$crate/src/lib.rs && \
    echo 'fn main() {}' > crates/$crate/src/main.rs; \
    done && \
    mkdir -p crates/cog-storage/src/migrate crates/cog-collaboration/benches && \
    echo 'fn main() {}' > crates/cog-storage/src/migrate/main.rs && \
    echo 'fn main() {}' > crates/cog-collaboration/benches/pge_cycle.rs

# Build and cache all third-party dependencies (strict: 失败必须暴露，不允许静默退化为无缓存)。
# fetch 单独加 shell 重试：镜像偶发单 crate 失败时，重试在同一层内进行、
# 已下载的 registry 缓存不会丢（层失败被 buildah 整体丢弃的教训）。
RUN ok=0; for i in $(seq 1 10); do cargo fetch --locked && { ok=1; break; }; \
    echo "[fetch] 重试 $i/10"; sleep 5; done; \
    [ "$ok" = "1" ] && cargo build --release --locked --bin cogneva

# Copy actual source code
COPY crates/ ./crates/

# 编译期被 include_str! 嵌入的那一份 overlay 资产表。cog-reflection 用它作为
# 「被部署 rev 的检出里读不到这张表」时的兜底（见 runtime_assets.rs 模块头），
# 所以它必须在 cargo build 之前就位。不放进依赖预热层：那一层用的是占位
# lib.rs，碰不到这条 include_str!，放进去只会白废一层缓存。
COPY deploy/overlay-assets.json ./deploy/

# 同一类：已发布配置文档的参照副本，被 cog-observability 的 include_str! 编进二进制。
# 少了这一行，从构建上下文出发的编译在 cog-observability 直接失败——而开发树与
# 本机发布用的是整棵树，看不见这条。哪些文件必须在这里，由
# deploy/scripts/check-docker-context.sh 判。
COPY deploy/helm/cogneva/files/cogneva.json ./deploy/helm/cogneva/files/

# Touch source files to invalidate cached object files only
RUN touch crates/*/src/lib.rs crates/*/src/main.rs 2>/dev/null || true

# Build the release binary
RUN cargo build --release --locked --bin cogneva

# Strip the binary to reduce size
RUN strip target/release/cogneva

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 1b: WebUI 构建（干净克隆也能产出 dist，不依赖本机预构建）
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FROM node:22-slim AS webbuilder

# 受限网络：npm  registry 镜像（如 https://registry.npmmirror.com）
ARG NPM_REGISTRY=""

WORKDIR /web

COPY web/package.json web/package-lock.json ./
# node:22-slim 自带 npm 版本有 "Exit handler never called!" bug（npm/cli 已知
# 问题，CI 容器内稳定复现），先升级 npm 再 ci。
RUN npm install -g npm@latest && \
    if [ -n "$NPM_REGISTRY" ]; then npm config set registry "$NPM_REGISTRY"; fi && \
    npm ci

COPY web/ ./
RUN npm run build

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stage 2: Runtime
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
FROM ubuntu:24.04

ARG APT_MIRROR_HOST
ARG VERSION
ARG GIT_REVISION

LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="cogneva" \
      org.opencontainers.image.version="${VERSION}" \
      org.opencontainers.image.revision="${GIT_REVISION}"

# 受限网络：ubuntu 源替换为镜像主机；buildah 在 universe 源，官方基础镜像
# 可能只启用 main/restricted，显式补齐组件列表
RUN if [ -n "$APT_MIRROR_HOST" ]; then \
    sed -i "s|archive.ubuntu.com|$APT_MIRROR_HOST|g; s|security.ubuntu.com|$APT_MIRROR_HOST|g" \
    /etc/apt/sources.list /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources 2>/dev/null || true; \
    fi; \
    sed -i 's/^Components: main.*/Components: main restricted universe multiverse/' \
    /etc/apt/sources.list.d/*.sources 2>/dev/null || true

# Install runtime dependencies (ca-certificates for TLS, libssl3 for rustls)
# and Rust toolchain so the self-evolution worker can build patches inside K3s.
# libstdc++6：ONNX Runtime（fastembed/ort）动态链接依赖
# buildah：自进化 publisher 打金丝雀 overlay 镜像并 push 到集群内 registry
# （仅特权进化 Pod 用；主应用 Pod 非特权，装了也无法使用）
# pkg-config + libssl-dev：沙盒内 cargo build 编译 openssl-sys 时 build script
# 靠 pkg-config 找 OpenSSL 头文件与链接符号，只有 libssl3 运行库必挂。
# protobuf-compiler：etcd-client 的 build.rs 用 tonic-build 编译 .proto，
# 容器内必须有 protoc 可执行文件。
# crun：buildah run 在沙盒内执行叠层校验命令（如 --version）所需的 OCI
# 运行时；--no-install-recommends 不会随 buildah 装它，build/copy/push
# 不需要运行时所以缺它一直没暴露，到 buildah run 才报 "exec: no command"。
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    ca-certificates \
    libssl3 \
    libssl-dev \
    libstdc++6 \
    curl \
    build-essential \
    pkg-config \
    protobuf-compiler \
    crun \
    git \
    openssh-client \
    python3 \
    python3-yaml \
    buildah \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Install rustup/stable toolchain. 这一把与上面钉住的 RUST_TOOLCHAIN 无关、有意不同：
# 它既给自进化 worker 在运行期编译系统写给自己、之后要落地的变更，也**就是部署器
# 编译主线二进制的那把**——`mainline_deployer` 在同一个镜像的 Pod 里跑 `cargo build
# --release`，不传工具链覆盖，所以「跑着的那个二进制是谁编的」读运行 Pod 里的
# `rustc -V` 就是它，而不是本文件构建段那把（构建段只产底座镜像自己的二进制）。
# 它跟 stable 通道（最新）⇒ RUST_TOOLCHAIN 这句声明**不覆盖**它：别把「Dockerfile
# 钉了版本」读成「这个镜像里的编译器是钉住的」。
ENV RUSTUP_HOME=/usr/local/rustup \
    CARGO_HOME=/usr/local/cargo \
    PATH=/usr/local/cargo/bin:$PATH
ARG RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER
ARG RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT
ARG RUSTUP_INIT_URL
# CN 模式同上：TUNA 无 rustup-init.sh 脚本，直接拉 rustup-init 二进制
RUN if [ -n "$RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER" ]; then \
    export RUSTUP_DIST_SERVER RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT; \
    arch=$(uname -m); \
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL "$RUSTUP_UPDATE_ROOT/dist/$arch-unknown-linux-gnu/rustup-init" -o /tmp/rustup-init && \
    chmod +x /tmp/rustup-init && /tmp/rustup-init -y --default-toolchain stable; \
    else \
    curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf "$RUSTUP_INIT_URL" | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain stable; \
    fi && \
    /usr/local/cargo/bin/rustup component add rustfmt clippy

# 受限网络：运行时镜像里的自进化/主线跟踪构建也要走 sparse 镜像。
# builder 阶段写的 /usr/local/cargo/config.toml 不跨阶段，这里必须重写一份，
# 否则沙盒内 cargo 直连 crates.io，家庭网络上索引拉取慢到构建超时。
ARG CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE
RUN if [ -n "$CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE" ]; then \
    mkdir -p /usr/local/cargo && \
    printf '[source.crates-io]\nreplace-with = "mirror"\n[source.mirror]\nregistry = "sparse+%s"\n\n[http]\nmultiplexing = false\n\n[net]\nretry = 10\n' "$CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE" > /usr/local/cargo/config.toml; \
    fi

# Create FHS directory structure
RUN mkdir -p /opt/cogneva /var/lib/cogneva-data /etc/cogneva /run/cogneva

# Create non-root user (overridden to root in evolution mode for build tooling)
RUN groupadd -r cogneva -g 1001 && \
    useradd -r -g cogneva -u 1001 -d /opt/cogneva -s /sbin/nologin cogneva

# Copy the built binary
COPY --from=builder /build/target/release/cogneva /opt/cogneva/cogneva

# Copy SQL migrations so the storage plugin can apply them at runtime
COPY --from=builder /build/crates/cog-storage/migrations /opt/cogneva/crates/cog-storage/migrations

# WebUI 静态资源（网关同源直接服务，浏览器打开即用）
COPY --from=webbuilder /web/dist /opt/cogneva/web

# 执行器表的三行样例（planner/generator/evaluator）。表可以为空——空表时目标照常分解，
# 只是 planner 点不到已登记的种类，且这几类手不再声明自己的工具边界（不声明＝拿整个注册表），
# 所以镜像是带着样例发的，不是带着必需品。运维可以删、可以改、可以加自己的行。
COPY skills /opt/cogneva/skills

# Set ownership
RUN chown -R cogneva:cogneva /opt/cogneva /var/lib/cogneva-data /etc/cogneva && \
    chmod +x /opt/cogneva/cogneva

# Default environment variables (overridden by K8s ConfigMap/Secret)
ENV SF_APP_NAME=cogneva \
    SF_APP_VERSION=${VERSION} \
    SF_LOG_LEVEL=info \
    SF_DATA_DIR=/var/lib/cogneva-data \
    SF_CONFIG_DIR=/etc/cogneva \
    SF_APP_DIR=/opt/cogneva \
    SF_DB_PROVIDER=mysql \
    SF_PG_PROVIDER=postgres \
    SF_VECTOR_PROVIDER=lancedb \
    SF_MEDIA_PROVIDER=local-sfu \
